'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Jack Faust LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jack Faust]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Random WYS
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
